# teltonika_rms_company (Resource)

A subsidiary company under an RMS account (`/companies`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "teltonika_rms_company" "eu_subsidiary" {
  name      = "EU Field Ops"
  parent_id = 125
  email     = "eu-ops@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable company name (3–200 chars).
- `parent_id` (Number) Parent company id under which this subsidiary is created.

### Optional

- `email` (String) Company contact email.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `device_count` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `level` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import teltonika_rms_company.eu_subsidiary 12345
```
